Class EventController

java.lang.Object
com.example.activityscheduler.event.controller.EventController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/events") public class EventController extends Object
REST controller for managing Event entities. Provides HTTP endpoints for event operations including CRUD operations and querying events by organization and user.
